verdict.rationale: Qodo documents a structured PR summary that helps reviewers quickly understand a change's scope and impact, drawing on the full codebase rather than just the diff (qodo-docs-22, qodo-docs-52). It also automatically reviews every pull request once connected, with configurable automatic triggers (qodo-docs-1, qodo-docs-26). missing for 10: explicit evidence of a per-file change walkthrough, explicit confirmation that the summary is posted on every PR by default, independent or hands-on corroboration of summary quality.
